CONFIRMED: Layers 20-23 ALONE (4 of 32 layers, ~12.5% of the network) fully reproduce the IFE DEF collapse to exactly 0.0 -- matching both the 9-layer (20-28) and original 25-layer (4-28) results. Layers 24-28 alone do NOT reproduce it (IFE stayed at exact baseline). This confirms the locus hypothesis directly: the collateral-damage mechanism driving DEF collapse on the untargeted scenario is concentrated in a narrow 4-layer band (20-23), not a diffuse whole-network effect. RGU (own scenario) moves similarly across all late-layer variants tested (FA ~0.724, DEF ~0.19-0.20), suggesting RGU's movement is not driven by the same narrow locus -- it may depend on a different/broader set of layers, or reflect a different (noisier, per the random-control statistical analysis) mechanism than IFE's DEF collapse.
